name: Giving Birth
overview: Scripture reveals that giving birth is both a divine blessing and a profound responsibility. God commands humanity to be fruitful and multiply, establishing the foundation for life and dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:28). While childbirth is accompanied by sorrow and pain as a result of the Fall (Genesis 3:16), children are ultimately portrayed as a precious heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3). The sacredness of birth is further emphasized through God's provision of life and purity laws (Leviticus 12:2) and the miraculous conception of Christ, the promised Immanuel, born of a virgin (Isaiah 7:14).
